source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text: Regarding the whisk, understood—I’ll source a more suitable option for that component. The spout shown in your image is possible, but reproducing it would require us to rethink the design, develop custom circuitry, and do additional custom work. To make matcha flow through that type of spout on demand, we would essentially need a solenoid that opens and closes a valve inside the dispensing mechanism. Developing a reliable solution would involve custom mechanical parts, wiring, and some R&D, so it would likely push us beyond the timeline for this 1st edition. Several off-the-shelf spout alternatives are available, though. Could one of those work instead?

ambiguity.description: It is unresolved whether reproducing the rendered spout should remain in the first-edition scope or be replaced by an off-the-shelf alternative.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Go ahead with that approach, and please match the rendering as closely as possible; I really like both its appearance and functionality. I do want one change from the rendering: move the plate labeled "Elena's Chai Whisk" from the back of the machine to the front. The spout and mixers will face the baristas, while customers will view the machine from another angle, so the "Elena's Chai Whisk" plate needs to face the customer.
